sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Kodou Takamine (高峯虎道正嗣) is a character from Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying manga series.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Kodou is the son of Hirachika Takamine and a master of Ashina Sword Style. He gets ordered to assist Doujun with his experiments and with a few men, he is send to find the escaped Yamahito. They end up encountering Hanbei and some villagers, and in their fight, Hanbei wounds Kodou's right leg. As the wound is too deep, Kodou is on the verge of dying and to save him Doujun turns him into red eyes. He ends up being defeated by Hanbei and thrown into the depths of the cave.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 1
sections.text: Kodou and few other men are searching the mountains. They end up encountering some villagers who believe that Kodou's group is a runaway brigands that wish to attack the village and fight them. They managed to kill the villagers but Hanbei then arrives and quickly kills two of them. Kodou then steps up to fight Hanbei, who manages to deflect his first strike, but Kodou then cuts him with his second strike. To his surprise, Hanbei still stands up.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 2
sections.text: Hanbei explains that he is "undying". They proceed to fight and Hanbei manage to overwhelm Kodou and inflicts a deep wound on his right leg, however just as Hanbei was about to kill Kodou, the other brigand stabs Hanbei from behind. Hanbei plucks out the brigands eye and prepares to kill him, but Kodou stabs his heart from behind. Injured and facing an undying, Kodou and the brigand decide to retreat.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 6
sections.text: Due to his leg wound, Kodou is on the verge of dying. His father then tells Doujun to find a way to save him.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 7
sections.text:
Kodou is healed thanks to the rejuvenating waters. He recalls a time when he was summoned at Ashina Castle. On his way upstairs, he is annoyed that he is ordered to assist Doujun with his experiments, and is angry that a 250 years old clan is forced to take order from a 20 years old clan. He sees Genichiro Ashina going down the stairs, Isshin's adopted son, and feels that he can easily take him out with his sword, but before he can realize it, Genichiro gets close to him, causing him to wonder if Genichiro felt his bloodlust. Looking at him, Genichiro recognizes that he is Takamine, and tells him that he is in his care.
Hanbei finds Kodou, who sees that Hanbei has Takamine's sword, so he guesses that his father is dead. That reaffirms his belief that he must be the one to restore glory to his clan and intends to bring Isshin and Genichiro's heads as gifts to the internal minister. Kodou and Hanbei starts fighting and Kodou takes the upper hand and ends up ripping Hanbei open, causing a centipede to come out of him. He grabs it, and while preparing to rip it out, he tells Hanbei that power is everything, and even if power is no longer measured by sword skill, if he is undying, he could still accomplish everything. Shoukichi then shows up, throws a bottle of oil at Kodou and then lit a fire. Kodou is burning, but still turns and cuts down Shoukichi. As the fire goes out, Hanbei had healed as well.

sections.heading: Sekiro Side Story: Hanbei the Undying Chapter 8
sections.text: The two then proceed to fight. Hanbei had already see Ashina Sword Style Ichimonji two times, so when Kodou prepares to use it again, Hanbei manages to dodge and then cuts Kodou's arms. He then cuts Kodou's left leg and stabs him in the throat, and pushes him down the depths of the cave.
